web.title: Minimum Wage in Australia 2026 - Australian Unions
web.description:
# Minimum Wage Australia 2026
- Casual workers must receive at least a 25% loading on top of their hourly rate.

## **Minimum wage rates by worker category (2026)**
|  |  |  |
|-|-|-|
| Casuals | $33.05 per hour | Casual workers must receive a casual loading of at least 25% on top of the base hourly rate. For the National Minimum Wage, this is $26.44 + (26.44 * 0.25) = $33.05. |

### **Casuals**
Casual workers on the National Minimum Wage receive a casual loading of at least 25%.

## Frequently Asked Questions
### Does the minimum wage apply to casuals?
Yes, the National Minimum Wage applies to casuals, but with an additional casual loading. Casual workers on the minimum wage must receive at least a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate, bringing their minimum to $33.05 per hour from 1 July 2026.
